title: Runable: $21M for AI Agents to Grow Businesses
description:
AI agents can now go from building businesses to actively growing them. Indian startup Runable has secured $21 million in funding to prove it. This funding round, co-led by Susquehanna Venture Capital and Nexus Venture Partners, positions Runable to expand its AI agent capabilities beyond website and app creation into customer acquisition, ad campaigns, and business promotion across multiple platforms. The move signifies a major shift in the AI agent market, moving from creation to tangible business outcomes.  What does this mean for the future of small business ownership and marketing? Learn how Runable is aiming to provide real-world growth for businesses, leveraging AI to handle complex marketing tasks.  #AI #ArtificialIntelligence #Startup #BusinessGrowth #TechCrunch

Source: https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/26/runable-hits-21m-to-bet-ai-agents-can-go-from-building-businesses-to-growing-them/

scenes.narration: What if AI agents could do more than just build businesses? What if they could grow them? That's the ambitious bet one startup is making, and they've just secured significant funding to prove it.
scenes.speaker: a

scenes.narration: According to news from TechCrunch, the Indian startup Runable has just raised $21 million in a Series A funding round. This capital is earmarked to push AI agents beyond simple creation and into the realm of actual business expansion.
scenes.speaker: b

scenes.narration: The funding was co-led by Susquehanna Venture Capital and Nexus Venture Partners, with existing investors also participating. This investment values Runable at $65 million post-money, all in equity.
scenes.speaker: b

scenes.narration: So, what exactly does Runable's AI agent do differently? While many AI tools are focused on building websites or writing code, Runable is targeting what happens *after* creation: finding customers and driving growth.
scenes.speaker: a

scenes.narration: Their AI agent is designed to handle tasks like identifying potential customers, running advertising campaigns, generating business presentations, and promoting companies across search engines, social media, and even AI chatbots.
scenes.speaker: b

scenes.narration: The founder, Umesh Kumar, stated that businesses don't just need code; they need real outcomes. He posed the question: if you're paying an agency thousands for ads, could an AI do it for less? This highlights the core problem: the high cost and complexity of traditional marketing.
scenes.visual_query: person pointing at ad campaign data
scenes.speaker: a

scenes.narration: Runable started as an AI infrastructure company, building browser tech to gather data at scale. But they noticed users were increasingly asking their AI agent to create things like websites and slide decks. This organic demand revealed a broader need.
scenes.speaker: b

scenes.narration: This pivot towards a general-purpose AI agent proved successful. Within just three weeks of launching paid services in March, Runable went from zero to an annualized revenue run rate of $2 million. This rapid adoption signals a strong market fit.
scenes.speaker: b

scenes.narration: Right now, the platform allows users to build content like websites and apps using natural language. But the big push is into the 'grow' phase, where it's aimed at managing SEO, social media, and ad campaigns. Imagine an AI that not only builds your storefront but also drives foot traffic.
scenes.speaker: a

scenes.narration: The ultimate goal is for small business owners to simply ask Runable to achieve a specific customer acquisition target, rather than juggling separate tools for websites, analytics, and marketing. This streamlines operations and democratizes access to sophisticated growth strategies.
scenes.speaker: b

scenes.narration: Runable boasts about 1.7 million registered users, with the US, UK, and Japan being their largest markets. They're seeing significant traction, with Japan expected to become a top market alongside the US very soon. This global reach indicates the universal demand for AI-driven business solutions.
scenes.speaker: b

scenes.narration: Now, you might hear about AI models like Claude or Codex and think that's the core technology. But according to Runable, the real value isn't the underlying code or model itself, but the tangible business results it can deliver. It's the 'what' and 'why' of AI, not just the 'how'.
scenes.speaker: a

scenes.narration: While they didn't disclose exact revenue figures, Runable users consumed over 1 trillion AI tokens in the last 90 days. Around 60-70% of this usage comes from paying customers, demonstrating a strong conversion rate and customer commitment.
scenes.speaker: b

scenes.narration: It's not all smooth sailing, though. Runable currently operates with negative gross margins, partly because they subsidize AI usage for their customers. They're working with various models, including their own, and banking on falling inference costs to achieve profitability.
scenes.speaker: a

scenes.narration: The big challenge ahead is scaling these growth services effectively and profitably. They believe they can offer the same quality of AI inference at a significantly lower cost in the future. This focus on cost optimization is crucial for long-term sustainability.
scenes.speaker: b

scenes.narration: This $21 million isn't just about building better tools; it's about fundamentally changing how small businesses acquire customers and scale. It’s moving AI from a creator to a growth engine, empowering entrepreneurs with powerful, automated marketing capabilities.
scenes.speaker: a

scenes.narration: Consider the implications: an AI agent that can analyze market trends, identify ideal customer segments, craft targeted ad copy, manage bidding strategies across platforms like Google Ads and Meta, and even personalize outreach through AI chatbots – all autonomously. This is the future Runable is building.
scenes.visual_query: ai analyzing market data and creating ads
scenes.speaker: b

scenes.narration: Imagine a small e-commerce store owner who previously spent hours manually posting on social media and tweaking ad campaigns. Now, they can simply tell Runable, 'Increase our sales of product X by 15% this month,' and the AI agent takes over the complex execution, freeing up the owner's time for strategic decisions or product development.
scenes.speaker: a

scenes.narration: This shift also democratizes access to advanced marketing expertise. Previously, small businesses often relied on expensive agencies or lacked the knowledge to implement sophisticated growth hacks. Runable aims to put that power directly into the hands of entrepreneurs, regardless of their technical or marketing background.
scenes.speaker: b

scenes.narration: What business growth task would you trust an AI agent with first? Subscribe to AI Pulse for more insights into how AI is reshaping our world.
scenes.speaker: a

synthesis_claim: The next frontier for AI agents isn't just automating creation, but mastering the complex, outcome-driven processes of business growth, potentially democratizing advanced marketing strategies for small businesses.
signal_title: Runable hits $21M to bet AI agents can go from building businesses to growing them
